text:
maria: Heads up — sampleapp build is failing in CI after the auth env var rename and project-scoping change. Error is `401 org not found` when we call /v1/generate.
kevin: Did you repro locally? Which SDK/version? Node and Python both got the new env var parsing change last week.
maria: Repro on my laptop with node-sdk@0.11.2. Works if I set both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT but CI only sets REDWOOD_API_KEY.
sam: That sounds like the new precedence rules — we now require explicit REDWOOD_PROJECT when org-scoped keys exist. We tried to make SDKs fall back to `project` in config file but maybe node change removed fallback.
tia: Quick fix: make SDK accept `REDWOOD_PROJECT` OR `REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT` to ease migration. Also we should log a deprecation warning rather than hard fail for one release. :warning:
kevin: Agreed. The parity issue is between node and python. Python currently auto-derives the project from the API key metadata; node does not. Ticketed parity task here: https://redwood/issue/INF-421 (WIP).
maria: CI is blocked — can we patch sampleapp to set REDWOOD_PROJECT for now?
sam: I'll send a PR to sampleapp to read project from the `.redwoodrc` if env var missing. Patch will be small: `const project = process.env.REDWOOD_PROJECT || readRcProject()`
tia: Also need to consider key rotation flow. When we rotate keys using `rwctl rotate-key --project myproj`, old keys should still authenticate for 5m while rollouts happen. CI timeout hit because rotation invalidated a key during parallel runners.
kevin: That's a bug — rotation grace window is supposed to be 10m. Which service did rotation run against?
maria: It was the staging key via ops-run. I'm checking ops logs.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout of `ops/staging-keys` completed at 2022-11-18T14:02:10Z (id: roll-987). Old keys invalidated immediately per rollout config.
sam: ops config set `invalidate_immediately: true` for that rollout — we need a safety flag for CI-critical projects. Suggest `allow_grace_window: true` default for non-prod.
tia: Long term: SDK should surface a clearer error when project missing vs key invalid. Right now both map to 401 which is causing confusion. Add error code `401-PROJ_MISSING` vs `401-AUTH_INVALID`.
kevin: +1. Also add a client-side fallback: if 401 and no REDWOOD_PROJECT, retry once with `project` param from `~/.redwoodrc` and tag telemetry `sdk.retry:project-fallback`.
maria: I'm OK with that if we gate it behind telemetry and a deprecation window. Also need docs update in sampleapp quickstart about env var names.
sam: I'll open two PRs: one to node-sdk for fallback+telemetry, one to sampleapp to set REDWOOD_PROJECT in CI.
tia: I'll add a short migration note to the onboarding guide and ping support to watch for rotated keys causing CI flakes.
kevin: Can someone file an incident-style postmortem if we see more CI failures? This is exactly the onboarding friction we want to avoid.
maria: Filed INF-432 for the immediate CI outage.
sam: PRs linked: node-sdk#276 and sampleapp#99. Hoping to get hotfix out today.
tia: Thanks — and an action item: team owning key rotation to add a `--grace-window` flag to `rwctl rotate-key`.
maria: SGTM. I'll follow up in #incidents if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
